breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 把“几分钟决定生死”的抢救窗口拓宽成“几小时可救回”

breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 研发免复杂配型的超快精准溶栓与导管微取栓器械、阻断微血栓级联炎症风暴药物，以及在缺血缺氧期守住心肌与脑神经元存活的细胞保护剂。

master.definition_en: Acquired degenerative dilation or expansion (ectasia) of normal blood vessels, often associated with aging. curated.lethality_detail_zh: 绝大多数甲减呈慢性隐匿进展（怕冷、乏力、水肿、体重增加、记忆力减退），但长期未服药或擅自停药者在寒冷、感染、手术、镇静剂诱发下，可骤发致命性【黏液性水肿昏迷】——表现为严重低体温（<35℃）、心动过缓、低血压、低通气与昏迷，全球文献病死率高达30%–50%！此外，孕妇未治甲减可致胎儿不可逆智力发育障碍（呆小症）。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 每日清晨空腹口服左甲状腺素钠（L-T4）进行精准激素替代即可完全恢复正常甲状腺功能、正常生活与生育（孕妇需孕期增加药量并严密监测TSH），极易控制且花费极低。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: 全球死因统计未单列普通甲减年度死亡人数；急性失代偿危象“黏液性水肿昏迷”年发病约0.12/百万人，Meta分析总病死率约38.8%（30%–50%）。
annual_deaths_global.source: ATA Guidelines / PubMed Myxedema Coma Meta-analysis

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: 中国未单列甲减独立死亡统计；随着普遍食盐加碘与产前/新生儿足底血TSH筛查普及，先天性呆小症与重症黏液性水肿昏迷已大幅减少。

epidemiology.prevalence_global: 全球成人显性甲减患病率约0.2%–2.0%，亚临床甲减约4%–10%（女性显著高于男性）。
epidemiology.prevalence_china: 中国全国流调（Teng等2020）显示成人显性甲减患病率约1.0%–1.3%，亚临床甲减约3%–5%以上（随年龄增长及女性人群高发）。

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 120一分钟识别与避坑：长期甲减停药或高龄患者在冬季/感染后若出现极度嗜睡淡漠甚至昏迷、体温异常偏低（<35.5℃、浑身冰凉）、呼吸浅慢、心率极慢（<50次/分）及全身非凹陷性浮肿（黏液性水肿昏迷！），立即拨打120进ICU抢救！严禁给昏迷患者强行喂水喂药防窒息，严禁突然使用镇静安眠药或过度快速剧烈加温（致血管扩张休克）；急诊需立即静脉给予左甲状腺素（或经胃管大剂量负荷）同时联合静脉氢化可的松（先用激素防诱发肾上腺危象！）、保温与呼吸循环支持。

standard_drugs.drug_class: 人工合成甲状腺素（T4）精准替代制剂
standard_drugs.usage_role: 甲减终生核心一线替代治疗（每日早餐前30–60分钟空腹温水吞服，避开钙剂、铁剂、豆浆牛奶至少4小时）
standard_drugs.cost_estimate_cny: 约15–40元/盒（50μg×50–100片，国家基本药物，月费用仅约10–30元）
standard_drugs.cost_source: 国家基本药物目录及公立医院参考价

standard_drugs.usage_role: 黏液性水肿昏迷ICU急救时与甲状腺素同步静脉给药，防止垂体-肾上腺轴功能低下诱发肾上腺危象
standard_drugs.cost_source: 国家基本药物目录参考价

non_drug_therapies_zh: 切忌症状好转就擅自停药！每6–12个月复查甲功（TSH、FT4）调整剂量；女性一旦确认怀孕需立即复查甲功并在内分泌科指导下将L-T4剂量上调约20%–30%
新生儿出生后必须完成足底血TSH先天性甲减筛查，阳性者生后2周内启动替代治疗可保障正常智力发育
日常饮食适量碘摄入（桥本甲状腺炎伴甲减者避免长期大量进食海带紫菜等超高碘食物）
clinical_management.annual_total_cost_china_cny: 门诊常规L-T4药物及每年2次甲功抽血复查总费用仅约400–900元人民币；若发生黏液性水肿昏迷进ICU抢救费用约20,000–60,000元。

research_progress.breakthroughs_and_trials_zh: 软胶囊及口服液体剂型左甲状腺素（如Tirosint）通过提高胃肠道溶出度改善了伴萎缩性胃炎、乳糜泻或服用PPI患者的吸收波动；针对部分TSH正常但仍诉疲劳患者，L-T4+L-T3联合缓释制剂及甲状腺类器官再生医学正在开展临床前与临床探索。
research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 1) 约10%–15%患者即便TSH已调至正常范围仍持续存在疲乏、脑雾与体重难以控制; 2) 育龄期女性备孕/孕早期漏查甲功或擅自停药导致流产与胎儿神经发育受损风险依然存在; 3) 老年隐匿性甲减易被误认为正常衰老，诱发冬季黏液性水肿昏迷。

master.definition_en: Aquagenic urticaria is a rare condition in which urticaria (hives) develop rapidly after the skin comes in contact with water, regardless of its temperature. It most commonly affects women and symptoms often start around the onset of puberty. Some patients report itching too. It is a form of physical urticaria . The exact underlying cause of aquagenic urticaria is currently unknown. master.definition_en: A rare genetic interstitial lung disease characterized by diffuse lung disease of variable phenotype ranging from severe respiratory insufficiency in infancy to asymptomatic adults, due to surfactant protein C deficiency. Typical presentation in infancy includes dyspnea, cough, wheezing, and gradual cyanosis, with or without failure to thrive. Radiological findings include diffuse ground-glass opacities in neonates, later interstitial thickening associated with lung hyperinflation, intraparenchymal/subpleural cysts, honeycombing, subpleural nodules, or bronchiectasis. Infiltrates and air leaks are frequent complications.

master.definition_en: A rare disorder affecting the digestive tract. Its cause is unclear but may be attributed, in part, to increased collagen synthesis without adequate fibrolysis. It is characterized histologically by atrophy of mucosal villi and crypts with extensive subepithelial collagen deposition. Clinical signs include nausea, vomiting, diarrhea and weight loss. Unlike celiac sprue (celiac disease), a gluten-free diet does not predict a certain regression of the disease. The clinical course follows a progression of malabsorption leading to nutritional deficiencies, small bowel ulceration/perforation, lymphoma and infection. Prognosis is usually dismal.

master.definition_en: A childhood-onset epilepsy syndrome where the onset of the condition includes manifestations of cognitive, neurological, or psychiatric impairment, stagnation, or regression, due directly to the underlying etiology. The term developmental and epileptic encephalopathy (DEE) is used when both factors contribute to the patient’s condition.

master.definition_en: A rare genetic neurological disorder characterized by congenital or early-onset sensorineural deafness and adult-onset progressive leukoencephalopathy. Progressive cognitive impairment and behavioral abnormalities are observed in the second or third decade of life, sometimes preceded by mild developmental delay and learning difficulties. Visual impairment in adult age has been reported. No central nervous system calcification is reported.

master.definition_en: A rare closed dysraphism with terminal stalk characterized by persistent rudimentary spinal cord below conus. It contains non-functional neural tissue and is typically isolated. The diagnostic is suggested by attenuated conus without fat, further confirmed by pathological analysis (glioneuronal core with ependyma-lined lumen, nerve roots, and dorsal root ganglia). Differential diagnostic with intraoperative neurophysiological monitoring is mandatory as neuroimaging fails to distinguish it from functional conus.
